title_en: The Second Time in a Stadium
note_en: A 比 B 还要 + adjective is built in a fixed order: first what is being compared, then 比 and the standard, with the judgment at the very end: 喊声比他当年看足球时还要热烈 "the cheering was even wilder than when he watched soccer back then." 还要 adds a note of surprise: you expected less and got more. English can move "even" around, but in Chinese the judgment always comes after the thing compared with.
